data.title: MAG 777
data.about:
MAG 777 is the latest stunning development by MAG Property Development, bringing a perfect blend of modern design and luxury amenities to the heart of Dubai Sports City. This 22-floor residential tower features 252 units with studio, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments, each crafted to elevate your living experience.

Designed for those seeking a balanced lifestyle, MAG 777 provides flexible payment plans and competitive starting prices, making it an ideal option for both investors and homeowners.

characteristics_module.title: Why Choose MAG 777? Key Features That Set It Apart
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Location: Situated in Dubai Sports City, with easy access to key landmarks like Dubai Marina and Downtown Dubai.
  • Luxurious Amenities: Enjoy a health club, infinity pool, fitness center, and wellness areas including a sauna, steam room, and yoga spaces.
  • Flexible Payment Plans: Choose from three tailored payment options to suit your financial needs: Studio: 50/50, 1-Bedroom: 40/60, and 3-Bedroom: 30/70.
  • Spacious, Modern Design: Apartments feature high ceilings, floor-to-ceiling windows, and a range of unit sizes from 456 sq. ft. to 1,383 sq. ft.
  • Competitive Pricing: Affordable luxury with studios starting at AED 777,000 and flexible down payments as low as 10%.

location_tile.title: Prime Location in Dubai Sports City
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Located in the dynamic and thriving Dubai Sports City, MAG 777 enjoys easy access to major highways and is a short drive from Dubai’s key landmarks, such as Dubai Marina, Mall of the Emirates, and Downtown Dubai. The community is known for its world-class sports facilities, tranquil parks, and vibrant residential life. Whether you're commuting for work or seeking leisure, Dubai Sports City offers an ideal mix of connectivity and lifestyle amenities.

  • Mall of the Emirates - 16 Minutes
  • Palm Jumeirah - 20 Minutes
  • Burj Khalifa - 26 Minutes
  • Jumeirah Beach - 26 Minutes
